images.caption: The North Carolina Wall is a popular rock climbing location. It makes up part of the western flank of a mountain called The Chimneys - part of the Jonas Ridge, which forms the eastern rim of the Linville Gorge. The Linville River can be seen in the bottom of the gorge on the lower right in the photo, and the northern section of Lake James can be seen in the distance.Photo taken with a Panasonic Lumix DMC-FZ50 in Burke County, NC, USA.
